text:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming_tail_latency p99 > 1500ms in us-west-2 for 6m. Trigger: streaming_tail_latency_over_1500msp99. Auto-page sent to oncall. https://redwood.status/INC-2026-0423 :rotating_light:

tara (oncall): oncall ack. pulling up graphs + recent rollouts. Any deploys in last 20m?

dev (sre): yes — we started a canary for prefix-shard-rotation v3 at 2151228800, traffic 0->20% in ramp. I see cache hit-rate drop from 88% -> 47% at 2151229005. p95 increased from 180ms -> 420ms, p99 hitting ~2200ms. Stream traces show many "waiting for kv" stalls.

nav (runtime): logs show two distinct behaviors: 1) certain prefixes now resolve to a different namespace id because of rotation mapping, 2) TTL computation for rotated keys is returning 0/expired for some old-format keys. Example:
```
resolver.rotate(prefix=0x9a7c) -> ns=shard-17 (expected shard-3)
kv_get(ns=shard-17, key=prefix/0x9a7c) -> miss
```
streamer: stall waiting for disk lookup 1800ms
```

jamie (eng-platform): the canary included a migration that rewrites prefix metadata in-flight; it was supposed to be read-only until warm, but a bug toggled the active mapping for 20% of traffic. Rolling it back should be fastest option.

tara (oncall): deploy-bot, pause/remove canary. Also have we got hot paging / IO contention?

deploy-bot: request received: pause rollout prefix-shard-rotation:v3 by tara. Executing...

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 18% traffic. id: roll-2151230055.

dev (sre): paging ops/sec spiked 3x on affected shards, IO queue depth climbed and read latency from NVMe increased ~2.5x. We're seeing eviction cascades on a couple of KV buckets.

nav (runtime): after pause, cache miss rate slowly falling to ~30% but still > baseline. We still have stale rotated mappings for some workers. I can force a safe fallback to pre-rotation resolver for streaming read path as a quick mitigation. Patch would be a config flag flip.

jamie (eng-platform): I'll push a runtime flag: `runtime.rotation_read_fallback=true` scoped to us-west-2 as emergency. Need ~90s to propagate.

tara (oncall): do it. Also throttling idea: temporarily reduce max concurrent streams per runtime to limit IO pressure while warm completes.

jamie (eng-platform): applying fallback now and lowering concurrency to 75% on affected pools.

nav (runtime): after fallback, p99 dropped from ~2200ms -> ~540ms within 5 minutes. p95 at ~210ms. Paging ops/sec back to ~1.1x baseline. Streaming stalls largely resolved.

maria (customer-success): reached out to largest sessions: NovaCorp, PineStudios. NovaCorp reported interruptions in long polls, PineStudios saw degraded chat responsiveness. Both appreciate the rapid update. We'll send a targeted status update.

dev (sre): root cause hypothesis: migration toggled active rotation mapping flag prematurely, causing mixed-format lookups (v2/v3) to be routed to wrong namespaces + TTL logic mis-evaluating migrated meta as expired -> high miss rate -> backend paging storm.

tara (oncall): mitigation summary: 1) paused prefix-shard-rotation:v3 2) enabled runtime.rotation_read_fallback=true 3) reduced stream concurrency to ease IO 4) monitoring for re-warm. Immediate customer impact minimized.

tara (oncall): follow-ups / ownership:
- nav (runtime): write a postmortem on rotation migration logic + improved validator checks (ETA 8h)
- jamie (eng-platform): implement safe-read-only rollout mode and feature flag gating for rotation flips; add automated prewarm step (ETA 6h)
- dev (sre): tune KV eviction thresholds and add short-term shard autoscale policy for hot-eviction detection (ETA 4h)
- maria (customer-success): draft incident update to customers and handle any follow-ups (ETA 1h)

tara (oncall): handing off to night oncall @dev in 45m. If p99 creeps >800ms re-escalate immediately.

dev (sre): taking over watch. Instrumenting additional dashboards: prefix-hit-by-format, ttl-zero-count, per-shard eviction rate. Adding alert: "kv_eviction_burst > 200/s" to page.

deploy-bot: Annotated incident: pause_rollout, config_toggle(runtime.rotation_read_fallback), concurrency_reduction.

tara (oncall): closing live mitigation loop, incident remains open for RCA and the follow-up items. :white_check_mark:

maria (customer-success): sending initial update to affected customers now.

nav (runtime): quick note: if anyone needs a sample of the disputed keys or logs, grep `rotation-mismatch` in runtime logs; I'll collect for RCA.

dev (sre): adding timeline and metrics snapshot to internal incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2151230000/notes

incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to S2. Monitoring continues.
